build_slate_reward_gru_network: build a SlateRewardGRU network using build_slate_reward_network with state_dim, candidate_dim, candidate_size, and slate_size
create_slate_reward_gru_config: create a SlateRewardGRU dataclass instance with custom GRUParameters for dim_model and num_stacked_layers
check_expect_slate_wise_reward: check the expect_slate_wise_reward property to see if slate-wise reward fitting is enabled
configure_gru_parameters: configure GRUParameters with dim_model and num_stacked_layers on a SlateRewardGRU instance
set_fit_slate_wise_reward: set fit_slate_wise_reward to control whether the SlateRewardGRU expects slate-wise reward output
